name: cvgen
description: Client-first tool for creating professional resumes from JSON data and HTML templates. Features web editor, CLI tool, role-specific guidance, and PDF output. Perfect for developers and professionals who want full control over their CV presentation.

paragraphs: A local-first tool to generate beautiful, professional CVs from JSON data and HTML templates. Perfect for developers, designers, and professionals who want full control over their CV presentation.
features: 🧠 JSON-based data input - Easy to edit and version control
🖨️ PDF output - High-quality, print-ready CVs using Puppeteer
🔧 Local-first - No cloud dependencies, your data stays private
🎨 Web-based editor - Visual editor with live preview (CV-JSON Web Editor)
📱 CLI tool - Command-line interface for automation
